name: Ample Classes Are Closed under Cartesian Products
statement: A Cartesian product on disjoint coordinate sets is ample exactly when both nonempty factors are ample.
proof: A support in the product is shattered, or strongly shattered, precisely when its intersections with the two coordinate blocks have the corresponding property in both factors. Equality of shattered and strongly shattered supports therefore holds factorwise. Each factor is also a coordinate section of the product, giving the reverse implication.
